record_notes.DCP-LETT-1783: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. November 21 with supplied 1855 year. Germination timing is species/variety-specific, differing fresh/old seed and uncertain denominators preserved; 30/56 Capsicum is one measured count, not a universal percentage. Hooker points to Linnæus sentence; Darwin asks meaning instead of adopting an unverified seabed mechanism. P.S. corrects November 13 plants/plots misprint; postscript resides within same extracted P1 and must retain boundary and quote offsets.

reading_method: Root independently read complete surviving new source bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly sections and bibliography. Actual special markup and figures inspected where present. Reused explicit accepted primary readings only after matching source and accepted evidence hashes. Historical decisions and notes are handwritten; validation packages evidence rather than adjudicating it.
